authored._provenance: authored from the committed live node catalogue rag/catalog/h22.0.400/ (scripts/build_node_catalog.py on H22.0.400: the type-level hou.NodeType.parmTemplateGroup() walk — VERIFIED-RUNTIME by construction, 222 Lop types; Vop.json carries the Vop-resident shader types), with connectivity_22.json as the advisory probe_confirmed cross-check; carried verbatim, NOT re-derived by this script; re-author on source_digest mismatch. source_digest = blake2b over the sha256 of Lop.json + Vop.json plus connectivity_22.json's blake2b stamp. Tier notes: usd_type is semantic USD-schema knowledge carried at authored tier (the catalogue records parm templates, not USD prim classes); key_parms use TEMPLATE spellings (t/r/s tuple parms cover tx..sz components; multiparm templates carry '#', runtime instance 1 is '1'). Carried-not-re-proved on 22.0.400: createNode('domelight'/'distantlight'/'light') version resolution (recorded by the 22.0.368 creation probe; the catalogue records the type table only), and materiallibrary's cook(force=True) gotcha (H21-era operational knowledge; no catalogue walk can prove cook behaviour).

reference.use: import assets under a prim path; per-instance overrides

sublayer.use: merge a full layer (environments, lighting rigs, base layers)

gotchas: primpattern#/matspecpath# are multiparm TEMPLATES on 22.0.400 — the H21 catalog carried the instance spellings primpattern1/matspecpath1, which have no parm template; created nodes expose instance 1 as primpattern1/matspecpath1.
Transform templates are the t/r tuple parms on 22.0.400 — component spellings (tx..rz) are not template names.
The H21-era 'instancer' spelling is gone from the 22.0.400 type table; the instancer tab resolves here — author the canonical 'copytopoints' spelling.

On 22.0.400 the versioned distantlight::2.0 template carries the punycode-namespaced UsdLux inputs (xn__inputs*); the plain intensity/exposure spellings live only on the legacy unversioned distantlight template. (createNode('distantlight') resolved to the ::2.0 type on the 22.0.368 creation probe; the 22.0.400 catalogue records the type table, not creation resolution.)

On 22.0.400 the versioned domelight::3.0 template carries the punycode-namespaced UsdLux inputs (xn__inputs*); the plain intensity/exposure/xn__texturefile_0ta spellings live only on the legacy unversioned domelight template. (createNode('domelight') resolved to the ::3.0 type on the 22.0.368 creation probe; the 22.0.400 catalogue records the type table, not creation resolution.)
DEPRECATED on 22.0.400 (catalogue deprecation flag) — still resolves; prefer karmarendersettings.

The consolidated light LOP supersedes the H21-era per-shape lights (sphere/rect/disk/cylinder) — shape via the lighttype parm, so usd_type varies with it. The versioned light::2.0 template on 22.0.400 carries the punycode-namespaced UsdLux inputs (xn__inputs*): per-shape dims at xn__inputsradius_mva / xn__inputswidth_zta / xn__inputsheight_mva / xn__inputslength_mva. (createNode('light') resolved to light::2.0 on the 22.0.368 creation probe; the 22.0.400 catalogue records the type table, not creation resolution.)

After creating materiallibrary, call matlib.cook(force=True) before creating child shader nodes, else createNode() returns None. (H21-era operational knowledge; NOT re-proved by the 22.0.400 catalogue walk.)

NOT a Lop type on 22.0.400 — it resolves only in the Vop category (rag/catalog/h22.0.400/Vop.json); create it INSIDE a materiallibrary as a child shader node. (Creation at /stage failed 'Invalid node type name' on the 22.0.368 creation probe.)
real LOP type on 22.0.400 — NEW in H22; the H21 catalog marked plane known_absent.
filepath# is a multiparm template — created nodes expose instance 1 as filepath1.
The H21-era 'position' parm is gone on 22.0.400 — use positionindex/positiontype; filepath# is a multiparm template (instance 1 is filepath1).

cylinderlight.remediation: no cylinderlight LOP on 22.0.400 — use the consolidated light LOP (versioned light::2.0) and set its lighttype parm to the cylinder shape

disklight.remediation: no disklight LOP on 22.0.400 — use the consolidated light LOP (versioned light::2.0) and set its lighttype parm to the disk shape

grid.remediation: there is NO grid LOP on 22.0.400 (grid is a Sop type) — use the plane LOP (a real LOP type on 22.0.400) or a cube scaled flat

instancer.remediation: gone from the 22.0.400 type table (lop_has_instancer false in the live .400 harvest) — the instancer tab resolves to copytopoints (a silent-success trap); author the canonical copytopoints (or pointinstancer for PointInstancer prims) instead

rectlight.remediation: no rectlight LOP on 22.0.400 — use the consolidated light LOP (versioned light::2.0) and set its lighttype parm to the rectangle shape

spherelight.remediation: no spherelight LOP on 22.0.400 — use the consolidated light LOP (versioned light::2.0) and set its lighttype parm to the sphere shape

ordering_rules.detail: assignmaterial binds material prims that must be authored upstream — usually by a materiallibrary (cook it, matlib.cook(force=True), before its shaders resolve), or brought in by a reference/sublayer composition arc; materials may also already exist in a pre-composed stage.
